title: CLCON/536/2019 of DEVI SINGH Vs JAI RAJ

paras.text:
MCC No. 1292 of 2019 (Recall Application)
CLMA No. 17124 of 2019 (Delay In Recall Appl.)
In
CLCON No. 536 of 2019
Hon'ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. H.C. Joshi, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. Pradeep Hariya, Standing
Counsel and Mr. J.S. Bisht, Brief Holder
for the State of Uttarakhand.
Heard learned counsel for the
parties.
Reasons furnished in the affidavit
filed in support of delay condonation
application are sufficient to condone the
delay. Consequently, the delay
condonation application is allowed and the
delay in filing the recall application is
condoned.
This application (MCC No. 1292 of
2019) has been filed seeking recall of the
order dated 04.09.2019.
Learned counsel for the petitioner
submits that whatever delay was caused
in filing the contempt petition is on
account of assurance given to the
petitioner that, as soon as budget is made
available, payment of arrears of salary
would be made to him.
Learned counsel for the petitioner
has referred to one order dated 31.10.2014
issued by Divisional Forest Officer,
Chakrata Forest Division, in which it has
been stated that minimum of pay scale
would be paid to 15 daily wage employees
named in the order as & when the budget
is available.
Having regard to the facts &
circumstances as mentioned in the recall
application and in the interest of justice,

the order dated 04.09.2019 is hereby
recalled.
The contempt petition is disposed of
with liberty to petitioner to approach
Divisional Forest Officer, Chakrata Forest
Division by making a representation
within two weeks from today. If such
representation is made within the
stipulated period, Divisional Forest Officer,
Chakrata Forest Division shall examine
the matter and shall take appropriate
decision, in accordance with law, within
six weeks from the date of receipt of
representation alongwith certified copy of
this order.
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.)
Arpan 16.03.2020
